name: Resonance Dissonant
description: Symphonie Ultime fusionnant toutes les harmoniques disponibles en une seule note dévastatrice capable de réduire des structures entières en poussière.

subject.archetype: Resonance Dissonant — Chœur Synthétique Legendary class faille_dimensionnelle

loadout.armor_outfit: Crystalline armor plates growing naturally from body vibrating at resonant frequencies with visible sound waves emanating from every surface, each facet catching and fracturing light into rainbows, organic-metal hybrid construction with legendary cosmic materials and ancient craftsmanship that has become one with the wearer's being
loadout.arsenal: Resonance tuning fork weapon humming at visible destructive frequency with air distortion around it, harmonic shield gauntlet generating visible ring-shaped sound wave barriers, crystalline conductor baton emitting visible vibration patterns The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's heal ability targeting damaged_friendly, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Compassionate reaching with healing tendrils specifically seeking wounded while bypassing healthy ones, showing visible triage intelligence in selective energy distribution
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — no longer merely fighting but reshaping the battlefield itself with every movement and breath

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.role: primary_accent — resonance energy beams and crystal shards

palette_names.name: Silver Prismatic
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — sound wave visualization and reflections

color_and_light.lighting_setup: aurum-plated frame with living energy flowing through ornate faction-specific patterns, border radiates golden glow, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Cinematic ultra-wide angle with dramatic depth layers — foreground devastation, character as glowing focal point, background cataclysm, sky and environment permanently altered

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater turned battlefield with crystal formations exploding from harmonic overload sending shards every direction, visible shockwave rings tearing through enemy positions, fragments raining from resonating cracked ceiling structures, entire environment vibrating at a frequency that makes air appear to ripple and distort
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Multiple precise healing streams finding wounded targets through battlefield clutter like guided missiles of life, each bypassing healthy allies to reach only those who need help, Only damaged areas respond to healing — cracked ground where wounded stand repairing while undamaged remains scarred, showing precision of targeted healing, Visible concentric sound waves expanding outward shattering nearby crystal structures into cascading shards, crystal fragments flying through air catching prismatic light, air visibly rippling and bending from sonic force, ground fracturing in geometric patterns from bass, floating debris suspended in harmonic stasis field
